logMaxSizeMb.description: Max total log folder size in MB. 0 = unlimited.

logCleanupIntervalMin.description: How often to check log folder size (minutes). 0 = startup only.

workflowFirst.description: When true, all modules start in WORKFLOW mode by default. The task executor lifecycle is fully delegated to workflow templates (workflowOwnsTaskLifecycle). Bosun acts as a thin shell around the workflow engine.

workflowOwnsTaskLifecycle.description: Delegate task finalization and recovery to workflow automation instead of the legacy TaskExecutor. Automatically set to true when workflowFirst is enabled.

workflowRiskyActionApprovalsEnabled.description: Require operator approval before workflows execute irreversible actions such as push, PR creation, destructive git cleanup, and Bosun task deletion.

workflowWorktreeRecoveryCooldownMin.description: Minutes to keep a task blocked after a non-retryable worktree acquisition failure before Bosun returns it to todo automatically.

worktreeBootstrap.description: Bootstrap policy for managed worktrees, including optional shared dependency links and per-ecosystem install/restore commands.

linkSharedPaths.description: Link reusable dependency directories from the repo root into each managed worktree when possible.

commandTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to allow each bootstrap command to run inside a managed worktree.

setupScript.description: Optional repo-specific shell command to run inside every managed worktree before stack bootstrap commands. Useful for local environment setup, SDK hook scaffolding, or repository-specific bootstrap fixes.

commandsByStack.description: Override bootstrap commands by detected ecosystem id such as node, python, go, rust, java, dotnet, ruby, php, or make.

sharedPathsByStack.description: Override reusable relative paths to link from the repo root into a managed worktree for each detected ecosystem.

profile.description: Default workflow setup profile (for example: balanced, autonomous, workflowFirst).

autoInstall.description: Automatically install requested templates on startup.

templateOverridesById.description: Template variable overrides keyed by template id.

source.description: Path to the internal harness profile source file. Supports JSON or markdown fenced JSON.

primaryExecutor.description: Named Harness executor ID to use as the default interactive/runtime selection.

routingMode.description: How the Harness runtime should route across named executors.

executors.description: Named Harness executor instances. These are the Bosun-native runtime selections exposed to chat, workflow, TUI, web UI, and Telegram when Harness is primary.

weight.description: Optional routing weight used when the Harness runtime spreads work across multiple executor instances.

workflows.description: Opt-in typed workflow templates that resolve to built-in workflow definitions.

options.description: Additional template variable overrides for this typed workflow entry.

prAutomation.description: Trust policy for PR automation. High-risk actions default to Bosun-created PRs only; trusted human authors are opt-in.

attachMode.description: How broadly Bosun applies its low-trust attachment marker. High-risk actions remain separately gated.

trustedAuthors.description: GitHub logins that Bosun may treat as trusted for optional non-Bosun PR automation. The currently connected GitHub OAuth login is also trusted automatically when present.

allowTrustedFixes.description: Allow Bosun to auto-repair attached PRs from trusted authors.

allowTrustedMerges.description: Allow Bosun to auto-merge attached PRs from trusted authors after the normal review and CI gates.

assistiveActions.description: Optional repo-local GitHub Actions that add labels and comments. Bosun works without them.

installOnSetup.description: If true, Bosun setup may copy the assistive PR attach and CI signal workflows into configured repos.

gates.description: Unified safeguards for PR policy, CI/CD merge gates, executor isolation, and runtime safety posture.

repoVisibility.description: Detected or operator-confirmed repository visibility used to recommend automation posture during setup.

automationPreference.description: Whether Bosun should favor runtime-driven automation or heavier GitHub Actions assistance when both are available.

githubActionsBudget.description: Operator-supplied indication of whether GitHub Actions runtime is available for heavier PR automation.

mode.description: When 'all', every non-ignored check is treated as blocking unless explicitly optional. When 'required-only', only checks matching requiredPatterns block merge.

requiredPatterns.description: Check-name patterns Bosun must treat as required before merge when using required-only gating.

optionalPatterns.description: Check-name patterns Bosun may ignore for merge blocking, even if they fail or remain absent.

ignorePatterns.description: Check-name patterns Bosun should exclude from merge-gate evaluation entirely.

requireAnyRequiredCheck.description: If true, Bosun blocks merge when no required checks are present after filtering.

treatPendingRequiredAsBlocking.description: If true, pending required checks block merge.

treatNeutralAsPass.description: If true, neutral or skipped required checks count as passing for merge gating.

sandboxMode.description: Operator-facing snapshot of the preferred executor sandbox mode.

containerIsolationEnabled.description: Whether container isolation is part of the expected safety posture.

containerRuntime.description: Preferred runtime for container isolation when enabled.

networkAccess.description: High-level network access posture for isolated execution.

worktrees.description: Readiness safeguards for Bosun-managed task worktrees only. These settings document whether Node-style bootstrap/readiness checks and push-hook enforcement are expected before task work proceeds.

requireBootstrap.description: Whether Bosun-managed task worktrees should require bootstrap before execution. Defaults to explicit worktreeBootstrap.enabled when provided, otherwise true.

requireReadiness.description: Whether Bosun-managed task worktrees should require a readiness check before execution. Defaults to explicit worktreeBootstrap.enabled when provided, otherwise true.

enforcePushHook.description: Whether Bosun-managed task worktrees should enforce the repository push hook before handoff or push.

enforceBacklog.description: Whether newly created work should be forced through backlog safeguards before direct execution.

agentTriggerControl.description: Whether agent-trigger safeguards remain enabled for untrusted or indirect sources.

markdownSafety.description: Safety controls for imported or runtime-ingested markdown, including allowlisted documentation exceptions and audit logging.

enabled.description: When false, markdown safety blocking is disabled while audit logging configuration remains available.

auditLogPath.description: Relative or absolute path for JSONL audit events describing blocked markdown content.

allowlist.description: Optional exceptions for known-safe repositories or paths. Documentation-only exceptions should set context=documentation.

repo.description: Repository path, slug, or identifier substring to match.

pathSuffix.description: Trailing path segment or filename to allow.

reason.description: Operator note explaining why the exception is trusted.

telegramUiTunnel.description: Mini App tunnel mode. named is the default permanent hostname mode.

telegramUiAllowQuickTunnelFallback.description: Allow quick trycloudflare fallback only when named tunnel startup fails.

cloudflareTunnelCredentials.description: Path to cloudflared tunnel credentials JSON.

cloudflareBaseDomain.description: Base domain used for deterministic per-user tunnel hostnames.

cloudflareUsernameHostnamePolicy.description: Policy for deriving named tunnel hostname from workstation identity.

cloudflareZoneId.description: Cloudflare zone ID used for DNS orchestration.

cloudflareApiToken.description: Cloudflare API token scoped to Zone DNS edit.

cloudflareDnsSyncEnabled.description: Enable Cloudflare DNS idempotent create/verify/update during named tunnel startup.

cloudflareDnsMaxRetries.description: Retry attempts for Cloudflare DNS API operations.

cloudflareDnsRetryBaseMs.description: Base backoff delay for Cloudflare DNS API retries.

telegramUiFallbackAuthEnabled.description: Enable admin fallback PIN/password auth when Telegram/session auth is unavailable.

telegramUiFallbackAuthRateLimitIpPerMin.description: Per-IP fallback auth attempt rate limit per minute.

telegramUiFallbackAuthRateLimitGlobalPer.description: Global fallback auth attempt rate limit per minute.

telegramUiFallbackAuthMaxFailures.description: Failed fallback auth attempts before temporary lockout.

telegramUiFallbackAuthLockoutMs.description: Temporary lockout duration in milliseconds after max fallback auth failures.

telegramUiFallbackAuthRotateDays.description: Target credential rotation interval for fallback auth.

telegramUiFallbackAuthTransientCooldownM.description: Cooldown when fallback auth backend has transient errors.

voice.description: Voice assistant configuration for real-time voice interaction

provider.description: Voice provider: openai/azure (Tier 1 realtime), claude/gemini (Tier 2 voice + provider vision), fallback (browser STT/TTS), auto (detect from env)

providers.description: Ordered provider candidates for voice routing/failover. First match with credentials is used.

endpointId.description: ID of the voice endpoint to use for this provider slot

visionModel.description: Vision model used for live screen/camera frame analysis

openaiApiKey.description: OpenAI API key for Realtime API (overrides OPENAI_API_KEY env)

openaiAccessToken.description: OpenAI OAuth access token for voice (OAuth preferred over API key when present)

azureApiKey.description: Azure OpenAI API key for Realtime API

azureAccessToken.description: Azure OAuth/AAD access token for voice realtime

claudeApiKey.description: Anthropic API key for Claude voice/vision provider mode

claudeAccessToken.description: Claude OAuth access token for voice provider mode

geminiApiKey.description: Gemini API key for Gemini voice/vision provider mode

geminiAccessToken.description: Gemini OAuth access token for voice provider mode

turnDetection.description: Turn detection mode for voice activity detection

instructions.description: Custom system instructions for the voice assistant

fallbackMode.description: Fallback when Realtime API unavailable: browser (Web Speech API) or disabled

enabled.description: Enable automatic realtime failover across configured voice providers

maxAttempts.description: Maximum realtime provider attempts per voice session token request

voiceEndpoints.description: Named realtime voice endpoints, each with its own credentials. Multiple endpoints enable automatic failover with context preservation.

endpoint.description: Azure OpenAI endpoint URL (required for azure)

delegateExecutor.description: Which executor to use for delegate_to_agent calls. Defaults to primaryAgent.

mode.description: Task source mode: 'issues' for repo issues only, 'kanban' for project board sync

owner.description: GitHub org/user that owns the project board

autoSync.description: Auto-sync task status to project board Status field

statusMapping.description: Map internal statuses to project board column names

webhook.description: GitHub project webhook settings for near-real-time sync triggers

path.description: HTTP path exposed by ui-server for GitHub webhook deliveries

secret.description: Shared secret used to validate X-Hub-Signature-256

requireSignature.description: Require a valid webhook signature before accepting payloads

syncMonitoring.description: Monitoring and alert thresholds for project-sync failures and rate-limits

alertFailureThreshold.description: Consecutive webhook/sync failures that trigger an alert

rateLimitAlertThreshold.description: Rate-limit events counted before triggering an alert

email.description: Jira account email used for API authentication

apiToken.description: Jira API token used for Basic authentication

projectKey.description: Default Jira project key used for list/create operations

issueType.description: Default Jira issue type for new tasks

statusMapping.description: Map internal statuses to Jira workflow status names

labels.description: Jira labels used to mark codex shared-state lifecycle

sharedStateFields.description: Custom field IDs used to persist shared-state payload

attemptStarted.description: Custom field ID for sharedState.attemptStarted (ISO timestamp)

heartbeat.description: Custom field ID for sharedState.heartbeat (ISO timestamp)

ignoreReason.description: Optional custom field ID for ignore reason

enabled.description: Enable the optional RepoMirror projection backend. Must be true before selecting KANBAN_BACKEND=repo-mirror.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repo or clone that will host RepoMirror projection data.

syncMode.description: Projection-only RepoMirror synchronization mode. Bosun keeps live runtime state in private storage.

runStorage.description: Where RepoMirror run metadata is stored when projection export is enabled.

messageStorage.description: Where RepoMirror message projections are stored. 'off' keeps agent-to-agent traffic private by default.

publicRoadmapEnabled.description: Allow sanitized public RepoMirror roadmap projection when explicitly enabled.

activeWorkspace.description: ID of the currently active workspace

primary.description: Whether this is the primary repo

activeRepo.description: Currently active repository name within the workspace

maxRetries.description: Transient stream retry attempts per run

retryBaseMs.description: Base stream retry delay in milliseconds

retryMaxMs.description: Maximum stream retry delay in milliseconds

firstEventTimeoutMs.description: Abort/retry if no stream events arrive within this timeout

maxItemsPerTurn.description: Maximum completed stream items retained per turn

maxItemChars.description: Maximum characters retained per string field in stored stream items

providers.description: Unified provider-kernel settings for auth mode, enablement, and model selection across chat, workflow, TUI, and Telegram surfaces.

sources.description: Auth source priority: env (tokens), cli (gh auth), vscode (extension), interactive (prompt)

fallbackToInteractive.description: Allow interactive login if all other sources fail

sources.description: Auth source priority: env (API key), cli (config file), interactive (prompt)

fallbackToInteractive.description: Allow interactive API key prompt if all other sources fail

sources.description: Auth source priority: config (config.toml), env (API key), interactive (prompt)

fallbackToInteractive.description: Allow interactive configuration if all other sources fail

workflows.description: Declarative multi-agent pipeline workflows runnable via bosun workflow run <name>.

provider.description: AI provider for this executor (e.g. anthropic, openai, ollama, nebius, scaleway, deepinfra, qiniu, cloudflare, xiaomi, synthetic, perplexity)

apiKey.description: API key for this provider (overrides env)

baseUrl.description: API base URL for this provider

model.description: Model ID to use with this provider (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-20250514)

agentHooks.description: Hook definitions loaded by agent-hooks.mjs (event -> hook list).

mcpServers.description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server management. Controls which MCP servers are available to agents.

enabled.description: Enable MCP server integration for agent launches

defaultServers.description: MCP server IDs attached to every agent launch by default (e.g. ["context7", "microsoft-docs"])

catalogOverrides.description: Environment variable overrides keyed by MCP server ID

useDiscoveryProxy.description: Wrap resolved MCP servers behind Bosun's compact search/schema/call discovery proxy to reduce tool-definition prompt overhead.

includeCustomToolsInDiscoveryProxy.description: Expose Bosun custom tools through the discovery proxy alongside external MCP servers.

discoveryProxyCacheTtlMs.description: How long Bosun caches wrapped MCP tool catalogs inside the discovery proxy before refreshing them.

discoveryProxyExecuteTimeoutMs.description: Default timeout for the discovery proxy execute tool, which runs short orchestration code against discovered tools.

autoInstallDefaults.description: Automatically install defaultServers from catalog if not already installed

contextShredding.description: Context Shredding — configurable tiered compression of agent context windows. Reduces token usage while preserving what matters.

enabled.description: Master switch for context shredding. When false, agents receive full history every turn.

fullContextTurns.description: Number of most-recent turns to keep completely uncompressed (Tier 0).

tier2MaxAge.description: Turns threshold for Tier 2 (moderate) compression. Items older enter Tier 3 (skeleton).

tier1HeadChars.description: Maximum characters kept from the start of a tool output in Tier 1 compression.

tier1TailChars.description: Maximum characters kept from the end of a tool output in Tier 1 compression.

tier2HeadChars.description: Maximum characters kept from the start of a tool output in Tier 2 compression.

tier2TailChars.description: Maximum characters kept from the end of a tool output in Tier 2 compression.

scoreHighThreshold.description: Items scored >= this value are protected from compression (tier shifted down).

scoreLowThreshold.description: Items scored < this value are compressed more aggressively.

compressToolOutputs.description: Enable tiered compression for tool call outputs.

compressMessages.description: Enable compression for agent reasoning and user prompt messages.

compressAgentMessages.description: Enable compression for verbose agent thinking/planning messages.

compressUserMessages.description: Compress old user prompt messages to a short breadcrumb. Current turn always kept full.

msgTier0MaxAge.description: Number of most-recent turns to keep agent messages in full text.

msgTier1MaxAge.description: Turns within which agent messages get a moderate summary. Older messages become one-line breadcrumbs.

msgMinCompressChars.description: Agent messages shorter than this are never compressed.

userMsgFullTurns.description: Turns during which the full user prompt is preserved.

liveToolCompactionEnabled.description: Enable command-aware live compaction of large tool outputs before they are stored in the active turn.

liveToolCompactionMode.description: off disables live compaction, auto compacts only when pressure or signal justify it, and aggressive favors stronger reduction for noisy command families.

liveToolCompactionMinChars.description: Minimum output size before live compaction is considered.

liveToolCompactionTargetChars.description: Target upper bound for compacted live command output before retrieval hints and metadata.

liveToolCompactionMinSavingsPct.description: Discard compacted output if it does not save at least this much space.

liveToolCompactionMinRuntimeMs.description: When command duration metadata is present, require at least this runtime before compacting in auto mode.

liveToolCompactionBlockStructured.description: Avoid live compaction for likely JSON or other structured outputs where exact bytes matter more than size.

liveToolCompactionAllowCommands.description: Command or tool families eligible for live compaction.

perType.description: Per-interaction-type config overrides. Keys: task, manual, primary, chat, voice, flow.

perAgent.description: Per-agent-SDK config overrides. Keys: codex-sdk, copilot-sdk, claude-sdk, gemini-sdk, opencode-sdk.

toolLogCache.description: In-memory caching of full tool log content for fast agent retrieval during active sessions. Reduces disk I/O on repeated context lookups.

enabled.description: When true, full tool log content is kept in-process memory for fast retrieval (avoids disk reads). Improves context retrieval speed during long agent sessions.

maxSizeBytes.description: Maximum total bytes to hold in the in-memory tool-log cache (default: 50 MB). Oldest entries are evicted (LRU order) when this limit is exceeded.

archiveSizeLimitBytes.description: Disk prune trigger: when the .cache/tool-logs/ directory exceeds this size, pruneToolLogCache is run automatically to reclaim space (default: 200 MB).
